title: E-Commerce Performance Benchmark
subtitle: High-Scale Load & Stress Testing (k6 / JMeter)
summary: Performance benchmark suite simulating high-traffic e-commerce microservices and profiling latency bottlenecks using k6 and JMeter.
overview: Performance benchmark designed to detect throughput limits, database query latency, and concurrency bottlenecks across e-commerce RESTful microservices.
responsibilities: Created k6 load test scripts simulating thousands of virtual users (VUs).
Identified memory leaks and slow SQL queries under peak traffic load.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Detecting system failure points under extreme concurrent flash-sale traffic.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Ramp-up load testing using k6, measuring P95 and P99 latency percentiles.

owaspMitigations.title: Broken Access Control (Session & CSRF Management)
owaspMitigations.description: Load scripts dynamically managing Anti-CSRF tokens and session cookies via regex/HTML parsers to validate authenticated flows under heavy traffic.
